description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) WIND-SWIFT EVASION (Stormlance Task Force, 1 CP) at the end of the Fight phase — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. Every engaged unit counts as having fought (setup privilege); the phase ends its Fight and Consolidate steps (REAL clicks); fight_phase_end opens for Player 1 (active first); a REAL click on the Outriders (MOUNTED, eligible to fight, still engaged with the Nobz) spends 1 CP; they make a FALL-BACK move: the move panel opens, REAL clicks on Auto-move and Confirm move; the Outriders end unengaged.
